en.shortDescription: Highly configurable homepage dashboard for self-hosted apps
en.longDescription:
Homepage is a flexible dashboard start page for homelab and self-hosted environments.

Show service links, bookmarks, and widgets from one customizable UI.

de.longDescription:
Homepage ist eine flexible Dashboard-Startseite für Homelab- und Self-Hosted-Umgebungen.

Zeige Dienst-Links, Lesezeichen und Widgets in einer anpassbaren Oberfläche.

fr.shortDescription: Tableau de bord d'accueil hautement configurable pour applications auto-hébergées
fr.longDescription:
Homepage est une page de démarrage de tableau de bord flexible pour les environnements homelab et auto-hébergés.

Affichez liens de services, favoris et widgets depuis une interface personnalisable.

pt.shortDescription: Dashboard de página inicial altamente configurável para apps auto-hospedadas
pt.longDescription:
Homepage é uma página inicial de dashboard flexível para ambientes homelab e auto-hospedados.

Exiba links de serviços, favoritos e widgets em uma interface personalizável.
